subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the column baseplate between Structural General

messages.text: The column baseplate reinforcement shown in Structural General Notes S-001 conflicts with #6 dowels at 12" o.c. noted in Foundation Plan S-101. This is becoming a priority on our end; we'd appreciate a prompt response. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. No schedule impact is expected from this clarification. We need direction by end of day Wednesday.

Proceed with #6 dowels at 12" o.c. per Foundation Plan S-101; Structural General Notes S-001 is superseded. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. No schedule impact is expected from this clarification.
